limit.description:
Normally the stream returned by Obj#generateObjs is infinite. If this must be artificially limited for some
reason, this field can be set.

example.description:
Generate "common, reasonable" field values rather than the full possible range of values. For example this will
produce a simple value like "17" for an `int` field rather than a uniform random number in [-2⁶³..2⁶³).

seed.description: Set the initial random seed, to produce a known series of instances.
